tagline: Your Smart Partner in Financial Growth

theme_and_archetype.selected_theme: Hybrid (Light/Dark mode toggle supported), defaulting to Light for trust, but heavily stylized in Dark for the 'Premium Fintech' feel.
theme_and_archetype.archetype: Archetype 1 (Organic & Earthy) blended with a refined Archetype 7 (Electric/Neon) via Blue/Teal glassmorphism per user request.
theme_and_archetype.emotional_tone: Professional, premium, yet highly approachable, trusting, and slightly playful.

typography.rules: Never use Inter or Roboto. Emphasize contrast: Heavy/Black weight for numbers and key headings, Regular/Medium for body.

layout_and_grids.landing_hero: grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-12 items-center min-h-[80vh]. Left: huge typography and primary CTA. Right: Floating glassmorphic app mockup.
layout_and_grids.form_wizard: Max-width sm (24rem) or md (28rem) container centered in viewport. 5-step progress bar above. Soft glassmorphism wrapper. Smooth height transitions.
layout_and_grids.dashboard: Bento Grid Mode B (Control Room). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6. Hero metric (Health Score) spanning 2 cols. Side column for action checklist. Pro Tip card floating bottom right (fixed or sticky).
layout_and_grids.legal_pages: Max-width prose (65ch) centered, heavy typography hierarchy, generous line-height.
layout_and_grids.footer: Generous padding (py-24), dark background even in light mode for contrast, massive brand logo text, organized grid for links.

component_specs.health_score_ring: SVG donut chart. Uses stroke-dasharray. Color maps dynamically to score (Red < 50, Yellow 50-70, Teal/Green > 70).
component_specs.language_toggle: Minimal pill toggle (EN | HI), standard shadcn Tabs or Switch variant.
component_specs.dark_light_toggle: Icon button (Sun/Moon) in header, uses next-themes.

hero_background.alt: Abstract teal and gray swirling patterns
hero_background.usage: Use as a full-screen or section background with very low opacity (e.g., 10-20%) or heavy blur to enhance the glassmorphism feel.

landing_mockup_1.usage: Hero section device mockup or bento grid visual.

instructions_to_main_agent: Files must use standard .js/.jsx extensions. Do not use TypeScript.
Use pure HTML/Tailwind for marketing layouts. Use shadcn/ui for complex interactive logic like the wizard, select dropdowns, and dialogs.
Implement the animated dog purely via SVG elements and CSS keyframes inline or in global CSS. Avoid heavy external animation libraries for the dog.
Ensure dark/light mode switches cleanly via next-themes (or similar context).
Never center text by default on marketing pages—rely on asymmetry and breathing room (Tailwind bento grid scales).
Ensure the Pro Tip card stands out using the provided shimmer animation classes and z-index.
Currency must be formatted in INR (₹) using Intl.NumberFormat('en-IN').
